_about: The forecast's inputs. Both the Model page (model/model.js) and code/forecast_curve.py read this file; edit here only. Probabilities are 0-1. low_case/high_case mean a lower/higher chance that he has left, so for the two timing inputs the low case is the slower one.

P_LIGHT.note: something improper beyond the affair happened and comes to light; raised to 98% (98-99%) on 2026-11-11 after the NYT reported a second relationship, with a direct report, and the WSJ reported the board is preparing to oust him

P_OUT_IF_LIGHT.note: he leaves, given something improper comes to light; raised from 90% (85-95%) to 95% (92-99%) on 2026-11-11

P_OUT_IF_NOT.note: he leaves over this anyway, given nothing more comes to light; cut from 7.5% (5-10%) on 2026-11-11

MEDIAN_DAYS.note: median days from as_of to the decisive finding or report; raised from 85, and the fast case from 45, on 2026-11-10; the slow case is a placeholder

LAG_DAYS.note: days from then until he has actually left; slow case cut from 30 to 25 on 2026-11-10

ORDINARY.note: chance per year he leaves for any reason unrelated to the scandal; cut from 2.5% (2-3%) on 2026-11-11
